title: HECM Modified Plans: The Designated Amount of the Line
content:
**Scope.** This calculation of the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) designated amount applies to a loan whose current plan pays no scheduled payments, such as the HECM Line of Credit, so no payment release arises and the available line after any release is the loan's available line.

**Definition.** The designated amount is the loan's available line less the amounts kept in the line, and 0.00 for a loan outside this scope, each amount worked out on its own and added to the amounts kept, floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. Nothing is kept in the line for the designation, so the amounts kept are 0.00.

| Loan | Designated amount (hypothetical available line 64250.75) |
|---|---|
| HECM Line of Credit, no scheduled payment | 64250.75 less 0.00, that is 64250.75 |
| any loan whose current plan pays a scheduled payment above 0.00 | 0.00 |

**Rounding.** The designated amount is rounded once, at the end, half up to the cent; a figure working out at 1000.005 is taken as 1000.01. A figure below 0.00 is taken as 0.00.
